change_units.title: CLI boundary
change_units.old_site: solo.cpp:64–67 — inline argc check, cerr usage, return 1
change_units.what: Three-state CommandLineStatus{run, help, error} replaces the inline argc guard; adds --help, unknown-flag rejection and getopt state reset.
change_units.why: A malformed argument previously surfaced only after backend initialisation had already run, and there was no --help at all.
change_units.impact: Argument errors exit before any backend work; the parser is reusable and independently testable.

change_units.title: Input contract
change_units.what: YAML parsing normalised into a PreparedInput struct: analyses, settings, event files, named processes and their cross sections.
change_units.why: The old entrypoint understood a single settings.event_file; the token "processes" does not appear anywhere in the SUSYRun2 solo.cpp.
change_units.impact: Multi-process, multi-file samples become expressible; fb/pb units and absolute vs fractional uncertainties are validated at parse time.

        - run02.hepmc

change_units.title: Batch execution
change_units.old_site: no batch branch — one settings.event_file, one pass
change_units.what: Each HepMC file runs as a CBS subprocess against a generated per-file YAML; results merge at signal-region level and sampling advice is emitted.
change_units.why: Production samples arrive split across files and processes; merging them by hand invites statistical error.
change_units.impact: Same process → event-count weighted; different process → summed in quadrature. The combined likelihood is recomputed, never summed from per-file loglikes.
change_units.verification: Source presence + call site at solo.cpp:274–285

change_units.title: Likelihood selector
change_units.what: A use_FullLikes setting chooses between calc_LHC_LogLikes and calc_LHC_LogLikes_full, and gates the three FullLikes function pointers.
change_units.why: On gambit/master this exists only as a commented-out TODO; SUSYRun2 hard-wires the _full path. This branch is the first to implement it.
change_units.impact: CBS can run without the ATLAS_FullLikes backend installed.
change_units.verification: master solo.cpp:119–120 is the commented TODO; grep confirms

change_units.title: Cutflow / histogram switches
change_units.what: Cutflow::set_check_cutflow and Histogram1D::set_check_histogram become runtime switches driven from the YAML settings block.
change_units.why: Whether cutflows ran was decided jointly by the CMake CUTFLOW option and a hard-coded true, so users could not tell from the config.
change_units.impact: The CMake option now only reports capability; the YAML decides behaviour. set_check_cutflow appears in neither master nor SUSYRun2.
change_units.verification: `grep -c set_check_cutflow` = 0 on master and SUSYRun2, 1 here
